name: Arabic Share-Alike Developer Composite Textpack
description: Generated Arabic recipe composite over the current component graph with local KB, corpus, and parallel payloads.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated share-alike recipe composite over the currently generated Arabic foundation, core, normalization, segmentation, lexicon, morphology, syntax, KB, search, corpus, parallel, and quality component graph. Wikidata and Tatoeba sources are materialized as local scoped payloads: Arabic entity/alias/relation rows, Tatoeba sentence rows, and Tatoeba parallel link rows. Quality components aggregate generated quality reports and evaluation evidence over those materialized payloads.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: Required component source rows are approved and either default-compatible, attribution-compatible, or share-alike isolated. The UD Arabic NYUAD syntax path remains isolated behind the package name's required -sa policy suffix.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: Policy-expanded Arabic MSA share-alike developer textpack for the currently generated Arabic resource graph. It includes the share-alike UD Arabic NYUAD syntax component explicitly and does not claim permissive default-package compatibility, dialectal Arabic, Classical/Quranic coverage, OPUS coverage, complete Wikidata dump coverage, neural models, statistical parsers, raw web corpora, or hidden network access.
